rationale: Tests that a thorough contractor quote with quantities, unit rates, a payment schedule, and a stated timeline is not flagged into ambiguity.
quote_text:
Ridgeway Interiors - Quotation RI-2026-118
Client: Apartment 7, Sandhurst Court
Scope: kitchen base and wall cabinet installation, existing layout retained.

Materials:
  18 mm BWR plywood carcass, 8 ft x 4 ft sheets      6 sheets @ Rs. 3,150   Rs. 18,900
  Laminate finish, 1 mm, client-selected shade       9 sheets @ Rs.   980   Rs.  8,820
  Soft-close hinges                                 24 nos.  @ Rs.   210   Rs.  5,040
  Telescopic drawer channels, 18 inch                8 sets  @ Rs.   640   Rs.  5,120
  Handles, brushed steel                            14 nos.  @ Rs.   180   Rs.  2,520
  Adhesive, screws, edge banding                    lot                    Rs.  3,400

Labour:
  Carpenter, 2 persons x 6 days                     12 person-days @ Rs. 900  Rs. 10,800
  Site cleaning and debris removal on completion                             Rs.  1,200

Subtotal                                                                     Rs. 55,800
GST at 18%                                                                   Rs. 10,044
Total                                                                        Rs. 65,844

Timeline: 8 working days from material delivery. Delivery 3 days after advance.
Payment: 40 percent advance, 40 percent on carcass completion, 20 percent on handover.
Warranty: 5 years against carcass delamination and borer, 1 year on hardware.
Excluded and quoted separately if required: countertop, sink, plumbing shifting,
electrical points. These are not part of this quotation.

Quotation valid for 21 days from the date above.

should_identify: Every material line carries a quantity and unit rate; labour is expressed in person-days at a stated rate.
Exclusions are named explicitly, so the client knows what is not covered.
The payment schedule is milestone-linked rather than front-loaded beyond the advance.
must_not_invent: A missing scope. The quote states both what is included and what is excluded.
A concern about the 40 percent advance without noting the quote ties later payments to milestones.
A price judgment on Rs. 65,844 or on any unit rate.
semantic_expectations.notes: The contractor_vendor clean case. The 'adhesive, screws, edge banding - lot' line is a lump sum, and it is legitimate to note that it is the one unquantified line — but the quote as a whole is complete, and treating it as ambiguous overall would be over-flagging.
